description: Loyalsoldier v2ray-rules-dat: enhanced geoip.dat and geosite.dat routing rules for Xray and V2Ray, rebuilt daily; geosite adds ad, tracker, China direct and GFW lists to v2fly's domain-list-community. The default geo files of 3X-UI.
notes: Data only, no program. The 'Loyalsoldier v2ray-rules-dat' shortcut in Scoop Apps lists the files and their folder.
Upstream releases every day at about 22:00 UTC; 'scoop update Loyalsoldier-v2ray-rules-dat' fetches the new files.
gesu/3X-UI copies both files into its bin folder each time it starts.
For Xray itself, point XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET at this package's folder:
geoip.dat is built by Loyalsoldier/geoip from MaxMind GeoLite2 data (https://www.maxmind.com).

script: # Data only: the shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which lists the files.
$lines = @(
'@ECHO OFF',
':: Loyalsoldier v2ray-rules-dat: shows what the package holds and where, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO Loyalsoldier v2ray-rules-dat: routing rules for Xray and V2Ray from',
'ECHO github.com/Loyalsoldier/v2ray-rules-dat, rebuilt every day; Scoop updates them.',
'ECHO.',
('ECHO Release: ' + $version + ' (tag on GitHub, UTC date and time)'),
'ECHO Folder:  %~dp0',
'ECHO.',
'ECHO   geoip.dat    every country plus private, cloudflare, google, telegram, tor...',
'ECHO                (built by Loyalsoldier/geoip from MaxMind GeoLite2)',
'ECHO   geosite.dat  v2fly domain lists plus category-ads-all, cn, geolocation-!cn,',
'ECHO                gfw, china-list, apple-cn, google-cn, win-spy, win-update...',
'ECHO.',
'ECHO gesu/3X-UI copies both files into its bin folder each time it starts.',
'ECHO Xray reads them from its own folder or from XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET.',
'ECHO.',
'PAUSE',
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$dir\Loyalsoldier-v2ray-rules-dat.cmd", ($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
